scope.zh: 多来源发现、原帖审核与互动数据更新（部分覆盖）
scope.en: Multi-source discovery, original-source review and metrics (partial coverage)

limitations: Accepted Fable cases are explicitly creator-attributed; backend model identity, routing and any official release were not verified. Posts that themselves speculate about Opus 5.5 being routed to another model were not attributed to either topic.

Configured endpoints, public catalogs and web/X/video searches are bounded discovery, not an exhaustive internet crawl. Every keyword-matched candidate in the resulting pools was reviewed against its original source; nothing was auto-imported. The 651 candidates rejected on 2026-10-12 were not re-reviewed (13 GitHub repositories resurfaced and were rejected again).

X search: 21 requests, 19 succeeded; two chains ended with a 404 on a later page and three chains (two Fable, one per-day Opus Top) reached the five-page cap. Top search is not a global popularity ranking.
Scientific validity, performance, costs and generation claims remain author-reported; no independent reproduction. Model roles are separated in multi-tool work.
Historical metrics: X 38/39; one post now returns 404 and keeps its prior values and timestamp. No new reply-thread audit.
